claims.claim: /design-login authorizes /design-sync; /design-sync converts and uploads React systems, with optional hint and potentially hours for first verification.
claims.limitation: Upload effects and code conversion fidelity untested. Manual Design MCP registration is absent from current reviewed instructions; no claim that endpoint is retired.

claims.claim: /design drafts artboards, requires v2.1.265+, enabled Design template and artifact-capable session.
claims.limitation: Broad A1 /design import/export/sync wording is not a detailed CLI contract.

claims.limitation: No credentials, settings or provider were changed.

claims.limitation: Import correctness and exact source component reuse require samples.

claims.claim: Standalone organization onboarding/Published and integrated migration/default selection are separate paths.
claims.limitation: No system published, default set, or migration performed.

claims.claim: Design exports include ZIP/PDF/PPTX/HTML and Code handoff; Google Slides is standalone-only; /design artboard PNG/PDF is a separate documented export.
claims.limitation: Actual export controls and usable package require stage 2; no native Figma export established.

claims.claim: Tutorial documents default bundle with files, chat and README plus URL prompt and Web option. Inspect actual contents before handoff.
claims.limitation: Default bundle content not observed; exactness and recipient access untested.

claims.claim: No Design version history yet; save request is documented but export reviewed baseline independently.
claims.limitation: No guarantee of reliable restore, complete history or conflict resolution.

claims.claim: Comments, multi-editor reliability, large repositories, mobile editing and incomplete imports have documented limits.
claims.limitation: No runtime incidence tested.

claims.claim: Usage shares Claude limits, with no separate Design allowance; billing differs by Enterprise arrangement.

claims.claim: Persistent assets, unsupported Design residency and special-configuration restrictions need tenant review.

claims.claim: Remote Figma plugin bundles server/skills; manual HTTP endpoint with /mcp OAuth is supported.
claims.limitation: No installation/authentication executed.

claims.claim: Figma read permission differs from native write; use_figma requires Full seat and edit permission for existing files.
claims.limitation: Historical Community account denial is not a universal editor-only read requirement.
